prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1231; do not mention it.)
text:
We are writing to advise that this office now represents the interests of our client in connection with the motor vehicle collision described above. Our client sustained injuries in a low-speed head-on collision, and we anticipate that a claim will be presented on their behalf.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter, including requests for statements, recorded or otherwise, and any settlement discussions, exclusively to this office. Our client should not be contacted directly by you or any person acting on your behalf.

We further request that you provide the full policy limits of all liability coverage applicable to the insured driver and vehicle involved in this incident, along with a copy of the declarations page for each policy.

Finally, we ask that your company take immediate steps to preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes vehicle data and telematics, photographs, claim file materials, witness statements, adjuster notes, and any recordings of calls with our client or witnesses. Please confirm in writing that these materials will be retained until this matter is fully resolved.
